ideas.title: Investigation into University Foreign Funding
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the universities that hid $2 billion in foreign funding, including the sources of the funding and the potential implications for national security.
questions: What are the sources of the foreign funding?
What are the potential implications for national security?
ideas.insight: The investigation into university foreign funding has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal with significant implications for national security. By following the money, we can determine the sources of the funding and the individuals involved.
